text:
Stuttgart’s median asking rents sit at 15.98 €/m², a modest 0.1 % rise year‑on‑year and 15.3 % up over the last five years, keeping the city the third‑most expensive of the 37‑city sample. The market remains balanced, with listings spending an average of 29 days on market and 23 % letting within a week.

Affordability is tight: a 60 m² unit costs about 959 € per month, pushing the rent‑burden for two residents to 18.3 % and the vacancy rate stays low at 1.8 %. The asking premium over existing rents is 54 %, reflecting strong demand despite a slight –0.1 % population decline.

The model estimate forecasts median asking rents of 16.7 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 16.35 €/m² and 17.22 €/m², implying a 4.5 % increase.
